title: Australia news live: Moreton Island fire warning downgraded; Melbourne’s final Metro Tunnel station complete
summary: Crews worked through the night to contain a bushfire in the popular camping destination. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The alert for the Moreton Island fire has been downgraded to “advice” level this morning after fire crews worked over the weekend to contain the blaze. The fire broke out on the island off Queensland’s south-east coast in dense national park near Eastern Beach at 10.30am on Saturday, forcing the evacuation of 20 campers to the western side of the island on the long weekend, AAP reports.
